# azureadb2c_trust_framework_policy (Data Source)

Reads one Azure AD B2C custom policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "azureadb2c_trust_framework_policy" "base" {
  id = "B2C_1A_TrustFrameworkBase"
}

output "base_policy_tenant" {
  value = data.azureadb2c_trust_framework_policy.base.tenant_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Policy id, e.g. B2C_1A_TrustFrameworkBase.

### Read-Only

- `base_policy_id` (String) The <BasePolicy><PolicyId> of the policy, or null when it has no base policy.
- `policy` (String) The policy XML as stored in B2C.
- `tenant_id` (String) The TenantId attribute of the root element, or null when it is not set.
